items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I have played approximately 3 or 4 concerts for him and he's a good guy to play for.

ctx.x: George Wein's festival. And Jack Kleinsinger, yeah, very much outstanding. I have played approximately 3 or 4 concerts for him and he's a good guy to play for. I like playin' for him. And--with the N.Y.U. concerts he gives. And who else. Gossman's in the Hamptons -- cause big people come up there, -- Gossman's club in the Hamptons, they hire me just about every year just about I bring big names.
-- Did the record date with Charlie Parker stand out --
